# AiDept Solutions

> AiDept Solutions is an AI consulting firm that helps small and mid-sized
> businesses (roughly 10–100 employees) adopt AI workflows that actually stick.
> Vendor-neutral and outcomes-focused: readiness audits, automation builds,
> employee training, and tool selection.

## What AiDept Solutions does
- AI readiness assessments for owners and COOs.
- Building practical automation and workflow integrations into existing operations.
- Employee AI training so adoption sticks after the engagement ends.
- Vendor-neutral AI tool selection (not tied to any single vendor).

## Who it's for
- Small and mid-sized businesses, typically 10–100 employees, in the United States.

## Engagement
- Offers a free preliminary consultation.
